name: Streaming Digital Transformation In Securities Services The Bnp Paribas Case Study 49884B5421
text: Digital Transformation in securities services: The BNP Paribas case study states that multidisciplinary use of AI, blockchain, and data could generate operational efficiencies and synergies. This supplies a proposed efficiency mechanism relevant to Kaal's observations about lower fees among advisers using the same technologies. The abstract provides no fee comparison and does not establish that efficiencies are passed through to investors.
